newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Karachi stocks end up on anti-Bhutto verdict hope.
newsitem.headline: Karachi stocks end up on anti-Bhutto verdict hope.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Wednesday as speculators bet that the Supreme Court would uphold President Farooq Leghari's dismissal of Benazir Bhutto's government on disputed corruption charges, dealers said.
"Speculators moved the index on hopes of an anti-Bhutto verdict, but genuine investors kept to the sidelines," dealer Sajad Mankani said. The verdict was expected later on Wednesday.
The Karachi index rose 11.11 points or 0.74 percent, to end at 1,511.95 amid 125 gainers and 96 losers. PTCL rose 1.15 rupees to 32.80 and Hub Power 0.65 to 38.80.
